notes.title: Welcome to Round 2!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060058/46ff7b2774472a6fd811537ad5db83cfbdc72aa7.png

Welcome to Round 2!

Round 2 officially started last weekend in preparation for our Steam launch as a way to continue to build our player base and grow our community on discord. Although the Steam version releases July 1st, you can start playing now by heading to our website.

Join us on Discord and get involved with the community and content development.

This game has been 5 years in development and 2 years in testing. I hope you all enjoy. I will continue to make improvements and respond to feedback through discord, the in-game help desk and bug tracker systems. Thank you!

~ Brian.
